Plugin.description: Overrides for one plugin; the table key is the slug on plugins.qgis.org.

name.description: Package name instead of qgis-plugin-<slug lowercased>. Needed when the default name is shared with another plugin.
name.title: Name

skip.description: Don't build this plugin, for this reason.
skip.title: Skip

note.description: Free text: why the overrides are there, e.g. where add_run came from.
note.title: Note

add_run.description: Extra run dependencies from conda-forge, e.g. Python packages the plugin imports but doesn't bundle.
add_run.title: Add Run

version.description: Conda version for an upstream version that can't be normalised automatically, e.g. { "2.0 final" = "2.0" }.
version.title: Version

license.description: SPDX licence id, instead of detecting it from the ZIP.
license.title: License

build_number.description: Raise it when an override changes an already published version.
build_number.title: Build Number

Plugin.title: Plugin

QgisRange.description:
QGIS range replacing metadata.txt's. It may only narrow that range: QGIS won't load
a plugin outside it.

min.description: Lowest QGIS version; two-part gets .0 appended.
min.title: Min

max.description: Highest QGIS version; two-part gets .99 appended.
max.title: Max

QgisRange.title: QgisRange

feed_lines.description: QGIS lines whose plugins.qgis.org feed is read. Each feed lists only the newest version of every plugin compatible with that line.
feed_lines.title: Feed Lines

test_lines.description: QGIS lines on conda-forge to test against: the oldest one inside a plugin's range, plus the newest QGIS.
test_lines.title: Test Lines

include_experimental.description: Also package versions flagged experimental on plugins.qgis.org.
include_experimental.title: Include Experimental

channel.description: Channel already published to, for `qp check`'s build-number check: a URL (https://prefix.dev/<channel>) or a local channel directory.
channel.title: Channel

import.description: Import the plugin in the test. Turn off for plugins with side effects at import.
import.title: Import

commands.description: Extra test commands, run with the newest QGIS and the package installed.
commands.title: Commands

description: plugins.toml: the plugins to package and how.

plugins.description: One table per plugin, keyed by its slug on plugins.qgis.org (exact, case-sensitive) and sorted case-insensitively.
plugins.title: Plugins

title: Config
